name: Victimize

abilities.text: Choose two target creature cards in your graveyard. Sacrifice a creature. If you do, return the chosen cards to the battlefield tapped.

notes: 'If you do' is the reflexive trigger (CR 603.12): it fires only when the sacrifice actually happened. The two creature cards are a real target requirement (return-from-graveyard with target: true), so they are chosen and re-checked rather than picked afresh; the reflexive chooses them when it goes on the stack rather than on cast, which is the closest the engine gets.
